download.command: uv run radiust download pt --latest --station PTST2 --output /private/tmp/radiust-pt-live-20260921 --no-cache --conf /private/tmp/radiust-pt-live.yaml --json

cat.command: uv run radiust cat --file <written NetCDF> --renderer text
cat.result: source=pt product=composite station=PTST2 time=2026-09-21T13:15:00.000000Z variable=rain_intensity shape=(1526, 1500) units=1 valid_range=0..0 missing=0.02%

limits: The public page reports rainfall intensity in mm/h, but the decoded raster stores ordinal legend intervals with unit 1, not continuous per-pixel rate estimates.
No displayed colored return is represented as below-detection, not measured zero rain.
The public page says the information is for informational use and not official evidence for weather-related incidents or accidents.
